author: Engr. R. Santos
title: Reliable radios for our dispatch team
body: FGT supplied and configured our NX-5700 units for the municipal dispatch center. Coverage has been solid even in low-signal barangays, and the IP67 rating has held up through the rainy season.

author: Maricel Dizon
title: Clean installation, responsive support
body: The CCTV turret cameras were installed across our road monitoring points with minimal downtime. Night footage is noticeably sharper than our previous system.

author: Engr. J. Villanueva
title: Good access control for our facility
body: Biometric + card access controllers work well for our factory entry points. Setup took a bit longer than expected but FGT's technicians saw it through.

author: Clark Freeport Facilities
title: Solid PA system for our events
body: The QSC speakers handled our outdoor event without a hitch — clear coverage across the grounds. FGT recommended the right pairing for our venue size.
